paragraphs: I am excited to apply for the Administrative Assistant role at RemoteHunter. With my background in event coordination and administrative support, I believe I can effectively contribute to your team's success.

Throughout my career, I have demonstrated strong organizational skills and a proactive approach to managing multiple tasks simultaneously. My experience coordinating events for International House Oulu, where I managed logistics, communications, and stakeholder liaison for 14 community events with an average of 25 international participants each, aligns well with the requirements of this role.

In addition to my event coordination experience, I have also worked in legal environments where I excelled at administrative tasks such as document preparation and filing. My ability to multitask and work efficiently under pressure makes me a strong candidate for this position.

I am committed to integrating into the Finnish business environment and am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised). I am confident that my skills, experience, and dedication will allow me to make a valuable contribution to RemoteHunter's team.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your organization.
